sub.customize: Choose a display name and optional icon. You can change everything later.
sub.needLink: Link your Discord account in Settings first.
sub.pickGuild: Pick a server you manage in Discord.
sub.inviteBot: We’ll open Discord in a new tab. Add Echo to this server, then return here.
sub.needBot: Open Discord, add Echo to this server, then keep this window open.
sub.exporting: Echo is copying channels, roles, and members. Large servers can take a few minutes.
sub.stuckSync: We don’t see your import request yet. Go back and tap Open Discord again, or wait and we’ll retry.
sub.connecting: Talking to Echo and checking your import status…
sub.nameServer: You can change this later in server settings.

busy.importing: Importing channels, roles, and members from Discord. Large servers can take a few minutes.

status.exporting: The Echo bot is exporting your server layout. You can keep this tab open.
status.stuckSync: Still syncing your request with Echo. Try the previous step again if this lasts more than a minute.
status.connecting: Connecting and registering your import with Echo…

addServer.initialSub: Create a new home for your community or join one with a link.
addServer.createOwnDesc: Set a name and optional icon. You can refine everything in server settings.
addServer.joinServerDesc: Browse discoverable servers or paste an invite.
addServer.useButtonRefresh: Use the button below, then tap refresh.
addServer.unknownNames: Some Discord servers were returned without a readable name. This usually means your Discord token is stale or missing scope. Try Refresh, then reconnect Discord in Settings if it persists.
addServer.notSetUp: Discord import isn’t set up on this Echo host yet.
addServer.largeSlow: Large servers can take several minutes — nothing is wrong if it’s slow.
addServer.noChange: If nothing changes, go back and open Discord again, or confirm the Echo bot is in your server.
addServer.joinSub: Pick a public server or use an invite link.
addServer.leaveImportDesc: You’ll exit the import wizard. A bot export may still finish on the server; to resume in the UI, start Import from Discord again.
addServer.needBot: Add the Echo bot to “{name}” in Discord if you haven’t already, then stay on this screen.
addServer.iconHint: Tap the circle to upload PNG or JPG (max 5 MB).
